# scalac 3.8.4's parent trees of A's classes (`teq tasty --positions` of scalac's pickles, generated by
# gen-pos.py): every class's parents, each node with a span, which the whole lean check build's pickles give
# the same trees in this order.
a2/W.tasty APPLY 27 .. 33 a/A.scala
a2/W.tasty SELECTin 27 .. 33 a/A.scala
a2/W.tasty NEW 27 .. 33 a/A.scala
a2/W.tasty IDENTtpt 27 .. 33 a/A.scala
a2/WK.tasty APPLY 84 .. 84 a/A.scala
a2/WK.tasty SELECTin 84 .. 84 a/A.scala
a2/WK.tasty NEW 84 .. 84 a/A.scala
a2/WK.tasty TYPEREF 84 .. 84 a/A.scala
a2/WK.tasty IDENTtpt 95 .. 97 a/A.scala
a2/WT.tasty IDENTtpt 71 .. 77 a/A.scala
